purpose: Teach: 間際/色合い/メシ/大いなる/不可解/非常識/あきらか/捜し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、登校間際に走るなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't go running right before we get to school.
lines.style: Light, dry observation tossed over the shoulder. Not a real complaint, more like a habit. Quick pace, almost affectionate in its bluntness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のシャツの色合い、お洒落だな、桜
lines.en: Your shirt's colour is pretty nice, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine comment that costs him something to say out loud. Slight hesitation on the opening. Softer than usual. Not looking directly at her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、いつもメシ抜きで来てんな
lines.en: You're always showing up without eating, you know that?
lines.style: Teasing but with an edge of actual concern underneath. Delivered like she's exasperated but also checking in. Familiar, sibling-energy tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、大いなる挑戦が待ってんだろ?桜
lines.en: Don't you have some big challenge waiting for you or something?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing tone. Sits with the question for a breath. Not pushy, just genuinely curious about what she's carrying. Softer inflection on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の問題、ぼくには不可解だぜ
lines.en: Your problem is honestly kind of a puzzle to me.
lines.style: Wry, playing at distance. But there's a real offer underneath — I'm willing to understand. Light, slightly self-aware laugh in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室で非常識な行動するなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't pull anything weird in class, okay Sakura?
lines.style: Low-key warning delivered with care. Not stern, more like he's looking out for her. Quiet but firm. The kind of thing only certain people get to say to her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の気持ちは、あきらかに勉強嫌いだな
lines.en: You're clearly not into studying, are you?
lines.style: Gentle tease, light observation. Knowing tone without judgment. Almost like she's figured something out about him. Slight uptick in warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、無くした鍵、ぼくが捜してやるよ、桜
lines.en: If you lost your keys, I'll help you find them, okay?
lines.style: Steady, quiet offer. No fanfare. Simple and direct. The comfort of someone who shows up when something matters. Soft close on her name.
